quoi: Run of the two real tools of "JSM Portal Answers" against the real portal
transport: asUser() proxied to the REST API of the site with the caller credentials (the Forge runtime is not available outside a deployed function); every call is a GET, asApp() throws

list_portal_request_types.reponse:
JSM Portal Answers — read-only answers about a JSM customer portal
Question: (every request type)

Portal: Support (SUP)
  Service desk id: 1 | project key: SUP | project type: service_desk
  Categories of this portal: Common Requests, Computers, Logins and Accounts, Applications, Servers and Infrastructure
  Request types (9):
    - Get IT help [id 1]
      you may raise it | status: OPEN | category: Common Requests, Computers | portal id: 1
      Description: Get assistance for general IT problems and questions.
    - Onboard new employees [id 4]
      you may raise it | status: OPEN | category: Logins and Accounts | portal id: 1
      Description: Request access for new employees.
    - Report a system problem [id 8]
      you may raise it | status: OPEN | category: Common Requests, Applications, Servers and Infrastructure | portal id: 1
      Description: Let us know if something isn't working properly and we'll aim to get it back up and running quickly.
    - Report broken hardware [id 9]
      you may raise it | status: OPEN | category: Common Requests, Computers, Servers and Infrastructure | portal id: 1
      Description: Report hardware that might be faulty or broken e.g. a broken computer screen or a damaged server.
    - Request a new account [id 3]
      you may raise it | status: OPEN | category: Common Requests, Logins and Accounts | portal id: 1
      Description: Request a new account for a system.
    - Request admin access [id 2]
      you may raise it | status: OPEN | category: Logins and Accounts | portal id: 1
      Description: For example, if you need to administer Jira.
    - Request new hardware [id 6]
      you may raise it | status: OPEN | category: Computers | portal id: 1
      Description: For example, a new mouse or monitor.
    - Request new software [id 5]
      you may raise it | status: OPEN | category: Computers, Applications | portal id: 1
      Description: If you need a software license, raise a request here.
    - Emailed request [id 7]
      you may raise it | status: OPEN | portal id: 1
      Description: Request received from your email support channel.
  Rules of this portal:
    - a request can be raised on behalf of another person: yes
    - participants can be added to a request: yes
  SLA targets: the public JSM REST API does not expose the SLA targets of a portal (its only SLA endpoints describe one request that already exists). The fields of the form are described by the other tool, describe_request_type_form.

Identity: the portal was read with your own Jira permissions, so you see the request types you are allowed to see. Nothing was written, nothing was stored.
